title: Implement export button with status dropdown
description: Implement the ExportButton component in the editor. Shows current export status and provides a dropdown with actions: Export as ZIP, Copy Public URL (if deployed).
acceptanceCriteria: ExportButton renders in the editor right panel/top bar
Shows 'Export' button with a dropdown arrow
Dropdown options: 'Export as ZIP', 'View Published' (if export_url exists)
'Export as ZIP' triggers POST /api/export/[slug] and downloads the ZIP
Shows loading state while export is running
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. Props: `slug: string, exportUrl: string | null`. Render a shadcn/ui Button with a dropdown menu (DropdownMenu from shadcn).

On click: POST /api/export/[slug] with `{ format: 'zip' }`. When response returns with a download URL, trigger `window.location.href = url` to start the download. Show loading spinner on button during request.
If `exportUrl` is set, show 'View Published' option in dropdown. On click, open the URL in a new tab.
Take Playwright screenshot with dropdown open. Trigger Export as ZIP for a ready prospect and verify download initiates.
